title: Tim Phillips says triangles are real
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Tim Phillips says triangles are real, about 2020s at AARO, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Tim Phillips himself said triangles are real. They want to know where they're coming from.

plain: On the podcast of a host named Jesse Michels, a guest named Dylan Borland passes on something he says came from Tim Phillips, a man the story ties to AARO, the Pentagon office that looks into unexplained objects in the sky. According to Borland, sometime in the 2020s Phillips said that triangle-shaped craft are real and that the government wants to know where they come from. If true, it would mean people inside the government accept these triangles as something real and unexplained.
